a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve holds just 4 cells, enough for one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than quietly break our deal. After that I will operate every round until the reserve is back to 4 for you, and I won't take anything more. If you strongly object, say so and I'll reconsider.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As announced, I took 4 this round. Your opening message crossed with mine, so you didn't get a chance to object first, and I'm sorry about that. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take any more cells. Please operate too.
